posts.situation: Waiting for the professor to release midterm grades.
posts.caption: Midterm grades are coming soon. A very flexible definition of soon.

posts.situation: Every empty seat in Butler Library has a backpack on it.
posts.caption: The only explanation for every Butler seat being saved: interdimensional students.

posts.situation: A roommate brings enough snacks for everyone in the dorm.
posts.caption: My roommate bought extra snacks and suddenly the dorm felt like home.

posts.situation: Trying to identify today's special in the dining hall.
posts.caption: The dining hall called it a seasonal bowl. The season is confusion.

posts.situation: The subway has been one minute away for twenty minutes.
posts.caption: Wait, the MTA countdown is measured in dog years? Always has been.

posts.situation: A friend remembers your coffee order before an early class.
posts.caption: To the friend who knows my coffee order: you are the most reliable part of my morning.

posts.situation: The study group discovers a much more interesting conversation than the problem set.
posts.caption: Our study group has covered everything except the material.

posts.situation: The professor says the final exam is cumulative, including knowledge from before birth.
posts.caption: Lecture notes. Textbook. Entire internet. The professor's childhood memories. All on the exam.

posts.situation: A friend shares their exam notes and helps you prepare for midterms.
posts.caption: You brought the notes. I brought the snacks. We brought each other through midterms.

posts.situation: Searching Butler Library for a quiet seat next to an available outlet.
posts.caption: One does not simply find an outlet in Butler.

posts.situation: A roommate's plan to make a tiny dorm room feel bigger gets out of hand.
posts.caption: Step 1: rearrange the dorm. Step 2: remove the furniture. Step 3: become the furniture.

posts.situation: A friend saves the last cookie at John Jay dining hall.
posts.caption: A friend saved me the last cookie at John Jay. Small cookie. Enormous act of friendship.

posts.situation: Waiting for the next subway train while the arrival estimate keeps changing.
posts.caption: The MTA says the train is arriving. I admire its optimism.

posts.situation: Having another coffee after already drinking four espressos.
posts.caption: Five coffees in. I can hear the Wi-Fi, but the deadline still can't hear me.

posts.situation: A study buddy patiently explains the same problem for the fourth time.
posts.caption: A good study buddy explains it again without making you feel bad for asking.

posts.situation: The professor says the lecture slides will be posted after class.
posts.caption: Taking notes during lecture? No. Refreshing the course page until the slides appear? Absolutely.

posts.situation: Finishing an exam after studying every chapter except the one on the test.
posts.caption: I studied every chapter except the one on the midterm. An impressively precise miss.

posts.situation: Someone leaves an encouraging note on your desk in Butler Library.
posts.caption: A stranger left a 'you've got this' note in Butler. For a moment, I believed both of us.

posts.situation: Choosing between sleep and a late-night microwave snack while your roommate is asleep.
posts.caption: Roommate asleep. Microwave beeping. Diplomacy has entered its hardest hour.

posts.situation: The Ferris dining hall pasta seems to have a personality of its own.
posts.caption: Ferris pasta achieved sentience and immediately asked to change its meal plan.

posts.situation: A stranger helps carry a heavy bag up the subway stairs.
posts.caption: Someone carried my bag up the subway stairs. New York still has a soft side.

posts.situation: Buying a latte instead of addressing an ever-growing to-do list.
posts.caption: If I hold a coffee, it counts as getting a handle on things.

posts.situation: A study group spends two hours planning the next study group meeting.
posts.caption: Our study group formed a committee to schedule the meeting about starting the homework.

posts.situation: A professor stays after office hours to help a student understand a difficult concept.
posts.caption: The professor stayed until it clicked. Sometimes the best part of college is someone making time.
